title: Fix permanent issue.* refusal on malformed SPEC bodies
intent: Commit, push, canonical verify.run, Draft PR
progress_summary: Root cause proven and reproduced on #4388/#4390: a body with a gwt-spec header whose sections index cannot be parsed made Cache::load_entry return None, so receipt renewal always returned false and issue.view/edit/comment were refused permanently with a misleading 'cache changed' message. Fix implemented: load_entry surfaces such entries with an empty SpecBody plus spec_parse_error; SpecOps::write_section refuses them (keeps the orphaned-comment guard); issue.edit accepts the body repair even on gwt-spec labels; the race message names the next action. Root-cause comment posted on #4392. GREEN: gwt cli::issue 89/89, gwt-github cache_test 28/28 and spec_ops_test 16/16, clippy and fmt clean. One unrelated http_client_test loopback-refusal test fails the same way on both runs.
